translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Anutuŋo Yuda Ŋei Ŋerep Magukoune Mawesakonge Eŋane Pauloŋo Qom Wikile Detke.

Na Kristo wane ŋei, so na isi mi ramaile, na don iwa ramaile, yemo welekatne. Naŋane wetne Asu Koboboineŋo warekaki paki, yaleka ma qelaŋane nolatmaikane, na isi mi ŋidanmaile, don welekatne ea iwa yale,
na qom borik detmaile, yemo zok kakapa, Yuda ŋei ŋerep magukopne eŋane qomne wikin nanmaike, tako rakot nae sola bikumne so weŋem sotakne!
Eŋane rawe paki, na maine Anutu wane soa bano waketpe paki, Kristo qeliŋkakalane eweke rap.

Eŋe Anutuŋo Yuda ŋei ŋerep ma wesake bira onge, eŋane ŋei ŋerep magu. Eŋe eŋine dokoine ebuke, so eŋine qeli ewe zonomine eŋe weneŋ ebonge, eŋe eŋerop tako rakot okangoi, paki ra rokop don ebonge, eŋe bakom mawa mawa wele makoi, eŋe Anutu wane biŋek don ea mawarekoi.

Eŋe Yuda ŋosa wili wilikopene ŋetne eŋano ŋine wakongoi, eso eŋane tego ea ŋine Kristo eŋe ŋei sola ma more wakonge. Oŋo yeye kine kine korop qeli so kepe pamaike, ea wane Waom okane wareon waremaike, ea wane Anutu maine bakomine kitokene, naso baŋem naso baŋem! Weleka.
Mali Malip Korop Eŋe Anutu Wane Magu
Na Anutu wane biŋek don yewa wele mi wakonge, yale mi ramaile, onoka wane Israel magu eŋe koropka Anutu wane maguka mi ma wesakonge.
Me Abraham wane ŋosa wili wilikoune eŋe koropka Anutu wane dokoine mi okangoi. Anutuŋo Abraham alakan don iwa yale olatke, “Isak wane doko ŋosakoune edoka, baŋ wakon onbe, geŋane biŋek okanikei.”

Don ea wane kine yemo iwa yale, ŋerep medep solaŋoka Abraham wano wakongoi, eŋe Anutu wane ŋerep medep mi okangei, ea wane turuŋine yemo, Anutu wane don ra togoleke, ea wane weleine ŋerep medep wakongoi, ea edoka Abraham wane ŋosa wili wilikoune wele okangoi.
Anutu donine iwa yale ra motki pake, “Naso motmaile, yewa bomileki, na baŋ koso zinge sariwe, Sara eŋe medep mane baŋ mayake.”
So weku iwaka mida, Rebeka wane gipoletkine ere magaetne wekuka, ŋenane qerakze Isak.
Ere nagaetne kotino ŋine wakone, kine kine maine me qotkoine mane mi okanbik paki, nagaetne kotinoka metpik, Anutuŋo Rebeka olale rake,
“Medep suaine oŋo ŋole nigatne eŋane qelit qeake.” Anutu eŋe don yale raki, ere baŋ ŋado atiksipo wakongoik, ea wane Anutu wane don wele okaniakane okange.
Ea wane Anutu wane papiao iwa yale ramaike, “Na Yakop wane similenange, ŋo Esau wane baune wake.”
Ea wane ŋene daleo raikene? Anutu eŋe masi maine mi okanmaike me? Yale Midakaka.
Eŋe Mose olale rake, “Na ŋei mane loloŋkawe ra, baŋ loloŋ kakale, so ŋei mane wet pese okan kawe ra, na baŋ wet pese okan kakale.”
Ea yemo ŋei wane similane, me urata mamainane mida, yemo Anutu wane wet pese, ea wane.

Ea wane Anutu wane papiaŋo Parao iwa yale olatmaike, “Na kine iwa yale wane ge ŋei waom bira gangole, na geŋano zonomne ma qelaŋanbe, ge naŋane zonom yewa sikan onikene, paki eŋet biŋekne ranom sua ariki kepe baŋem ŋei korop eŋe desikei.”
Eso ea wane Anutu eŋe ŋei mane loloŋkawe ra, loloŋkayake, paki ŋei mane wetne ma siukewe ra, ma siukeake.
Anutu Wane Sot Osi Osi So Wet Pesek
Ŋinano ŋine maneŋo baŋ iwa yale nolale rayake, “Kine yale pamaikeo, yemo Anutu eŋe onoka wane ŋei wane sot ea wane detki bori okanmaike? Ŋei maŋo Anutu wane simile ea qe esopkayake?”
Kimane, ge maŋo siluŋ Anutu don maine mainge olasikene? Gola qakatakŋo mamaine, eaŋo ŋei gola make, ea mi olale rayake, “Ge onaka wane na iwa yaline neukone?”

Ŋei gola ma okanmaine, eŋe qakatak mayakane simileineŋo ramaike, ea wane kop mamaike, paki gola etke qakatak wekuo ŋine ka epuyake, gola mane yemo yeye neninane, ŋo mane yemo yeye yauwinane motkei wane.

Kop weku eaka welekatne Anutu eŋe okange. Eŋe eŋine sot osi osiine ea wane kine sikan ongi paki, zonominane kine didiwo maki wakongi, detkaikei wane. Ea wane eŋe siluŋ ŋeiwa sot osi osi okankakoi, eŋe mo mataliongi midakei wano ŋine, ebu seseonge.
So eŋe qele ewe zonomine maune papaine, ea yaleka ma wakone ŋenano qakki wake, ŋene wet pese kapkoune, ŋenano ŋine natne eŋe eŋane qeli ewe zonomine maikei wane mo ewekkoi.
Eŋe ŋene ŋedan newanŋon okanmaike, Yuda ŋei eŋane keuo ŋineka mida, qelaŋ, Yuda ŋadino gemami, eŋane keueno ŋine weneŋ edora newan ŋonge.
Ea wane Hoseaŋo buko iwa yale qeke,

content.text: “Ŋei ŋerep naŋane biŋek mi gemami, na baŋ edora rakale, ‘Naŋane ŋei ŋerep.’ Ŋei ŋereppa na eŋane mi simin nange, na baŋ edora rakale, ‘Naŋane wasekopne.’
So matpa diawao edane rakole, ‘Ŋine naŋane ŋei ŋerep magu midaka,’ yewa eŋe baŋ mat yewaoka edora rakale, ‘Ŋine Anutu gegeinerop eŋane gipon boraso koune.’”

content: So Isaiaŋo Israel eŋane don iwa yale rake, “Israel ŋei ŋerep eŋe sua leuleu paki kiwet mezeno qalak pamaike, yale okangei, ŋo siluŋ etkemdeŋoka baŋ menaŋgei.
Waom eŋe baŋ don raki qoeki ikopka kepe baŋem ŋei turuŋine ebon wareake.”

Ea yemo Isaiaŋo don mane mikepka iwa yale rake, ea wane kop, “Anutu Togole welaine oŋo doko ŋosa natne qeliŋŋonge ra, yemo ŋene Sodom welaine, qelaŋ ŋei borikine eŋane kop marat kaŋem rap, so ŋene Gomora welaine, qelaŋ ŋei borikine eŋane kop okanŋem rap, so ŋene korop siukŋem rap.”
Yuda Ŋei Eŋe Menage Koboe Okangeiwane Ŋaŋaekoi
Ea wane ŋene daleo raikene? Iwa yale, qelaŋ ŋei eŋe menage koboe okangei wane mi soringekoi, ŋo mali malipenane ra more, Anutu wano menage koboe okangoi.
Pakiso Israel ŋei Anutuŋo ma wesake biraonge, eŋe ra rokop don teweke more, menage koboe Anutu wano okangei wane soringekoi, eŋe ea mi marat kakoi.
Eamo onoka wane? Iwa yale wane, eŋe mali malipenane rau paki, ea mi okangoi. Eŋe yaup urata mamaenane ra more okangoi, pakiso eŋe numao wesi pake, yewao kieene lagulok warekoi.
Ea wane Isaiaŋo Kristo wane ra more don saeŋine Anutu wane papiao iwa yale ramaike,

content.text: “Kau, Na Zion kepe yewao wesi mane motmaile, yewao ŋei ŋerep kieene baŋ lagulok warekei, ŋo ŋei mane eŋe detluk kayake, eŋe mi gamu kayake.”
